text.contents_aren_t_tracked: Contents aren't tracked for this kind of pallet.

text.durable_items_the_warehouse: Durable items the warehouse itself uses long-term (shelving, pallet jacks, tools, computers) — not for distribution.
text.email_them_a_link: Email them a link to set their own password
text.email_them_their_login: Email them their login details (the login address and their email — not the password)
text.email_them_their_login_2: Email them their login details (not the password)
text.email_these_addresses_when: Email these addresses when someone submits a bug report or idea

text.enter_a_quantity_of: Enter a quantity of 0 or more.
text.enter_a_quantity_of_2: Enter a quantity of 1 or more.
text.enter_at_least_one: Enter at least one change (use a minus sign to remove).
text.enter_how_many_labels: Enter how many labels to print.
text.enter_how_many_packs: Enter how many packs are in the carton and how many items are in each pack.
text.enter_how_many_pallets: Enter how many pallets to add.
text.enter_or_scan_at: Enter or scan at least one label number.
text.every_line_needs_at: Every line needs at least one fill record (even 0) before this order can be marked Filled.
text.everything_recorded_against_this: Everything recorded against this item moves to the new ACS #: its
text.item_line_s_are: item line(s) are staged for a Warehouse pallet — use Clear / new pallet to go back to them.
text.items_where_total_requested: Items where total requested across Ready-to-Fill orders exceeds on-hand. Suggested quantities are straight-proportional; need level is self-reported context. Saving sets each line's approved quantity — that's what the picker sees on the pick sheet and fill screen (a line approved at 0 is left off). Leave a box blank to give the picker the full request. Nothing here is required before printing or filling.
text.keys_and_passwords_are: Keys and passwords are stored encrypted and are never shown again after saving; a backup restored onto another server loses them, so they would need to be entered again.
text.line_s_have_not: line(s) have not finished saving and will be lost. Leave anyway?
text.lines_entered_without_a: Lines entered without a pallet won't be source-traceable.
text.loose_items_with_no: (loose items with no inner packs: leave Packs at 1 and put the count in Items in each pack)
text.no_active_locations_are: No active locations are set up yet.
text.no_labels_created_for: No labels created for this intake yet.
text.no_lines_yet_scan: No lines yet - scan a pallet tag, then start entering items.
text.no_pending_offers_on: No pending offers on file — this arrival wasn't phoned in ahead, or none of the current offers match.
text.no_questions_yet_add: No questions yet — add presets or a custom question below.
text.none_yet_they_are: None yet — they are added from the Sorting page the first time a carton is scanned.
text.nothing_has_been_picked: Nothing has been picked — completing will close this request as Unfulfilled instead of sending it to Shipping.
text.nothing_is_recorded_as: Nothing is recorded as being on this pallet.
text.nothing_is_recorded_on: Nothing is recorded on this pallet — add an item below.
text.nothing_sorted_from_this: Nothing sorted from this pallet yet.
text.nothing_to_pick_on: Nothing to pick on this order.
text.nothing_waiting_everything_sorted: Nothing waiting — everything sorted is already on a pallet.
text.of_its_ledger_rows: of its ledger rows are fills for order lines; those lines still request the old item type, so past orders will show goods of a different type than was requested. Orders themselves are not changed.
text.one_label_for_each: One label for each set of items put on this pallet, as it was added (picks and corrections since aren't reflected). Reprint any of them here.
text.only_one_banner_shows: Only one banner shows at a time. Choose a kind, add a message if needed, and save — every user sees it until they dismiss it or you change it again.
text.or_search_for_it: (or search for it) so every future scan of this carton counts the items for you.
text.organization_address_address_2: Organization, Address, Address 2, City, State, Zip, Tags
text.p0_is_not_a: "{p0}" is not a known active location.
text.partner_accounts_can_log: Partner accounts can log in, but ordering isn't available to them yet.
text.port_465_connects_over: Port 465 connects over SSL; any other port switches to TLS when the server offers it.
text.print_a_batch_of: Print a batch of blank R labels now, before any donation is entered — attach them to pallets as goods arrive, then key in the label numbers used when you record the intake.
text.provide_a_name_first: Provide a name (first + last) and/or an organization — at least one is required.
text.receiving_pallets_aren_t: Receiving pallets aren't tracked item by item; this is what sorting recorded coming off it.
text.record_address_where_this: Record address where this donation was picked up:
text.removed_carton_placeholder_its: Removed carton {placeholder}. Its next scan will ask what is inside.
text.removing_a_carton_barcode: Removing a carton barcode doesn't touch any item or anything already sorted. The next time that carton is scanned, the Sorting page asks again what is inside and how many, and saves the new answer. To change an entry, remove it and scan the carton again.
text.replaces_their_current_password: Replaces their current password straight away — for someone whose email isn't arriving. You'll need to give it to them yourself.
text.role_pick_one_it: Role — pick one; it fully replaces the permission set below
text.saved_pickers_will_see: Saved — pickers will see the approved quantities.
text.say_what_the_reason: Say what the reason is in the notes.
text.scan_a_pallet_to: Scan a pallet to see where it is, what is on it and move it — or build a new Warehouse pallet below.
text.scan_one_of_the: Scan one of the single items inside it
text.scan_or_type_the: Scan or type the code from this person's physical badge, if issued — used for PIN-unlock badge scanning.
text.scanned_code_did_not: Scanned code did not match an item for this line.
text.scheduled_maintenance_from_p0: Scheduled maintenance from {p0} to {p1}. The site may be briefly unavailable during this time.
text.scheduled_maintenance_starting_p0: Scheduled maintenance starting {p0}. The site may be briefly unavailable during this time.
text.separate_addresses_with_commas: Separate addresses with commas. With none, reports are still saved, just not emailed.
text.set_a_password_now: Set a password now — the account is active and verified right away
text.set_this_when_this: Set this when this person is a contact at an organization already recorded above (checked "This record is the organization itself"), rather than a standalone donor/recipient/contact.
text.showing_the_newest_records: Showing the newest {{ records.length }} of {{ total }}.
text.someone_who_logs_out: Someone who logs out won't disappear from this list instantly — their session just stops updating and ages out of the
text.tap_items_below_to: Tap items below to put them on this pallet.
text.tap_items_in_the: Tap items in the sorting area below, set where it is going, then Seal & Place. Scan an existing Warehouse pallet instead to add to that one.
text.that_was_the_last: — that was the last pallet, donation is fully sorted!
text.the_first_row_must: The first row must be headings. Recognized columns (any order, any you don't have can be left out):
text.the_from_address_must: The From address must be on a domain verified in the Resend account the key belongs to.
text.the_test_email_could: The test email could not be sent.
text.they_said_they_re: They said they're here as a
text.this_changes_history_not: This changes history, not just the catalog.
text.this_donor_s_past: this donor's past donations have had a high share of unusable goods.
text.this_is_a_self: This is a self-registered account nobody has approved yet — it cannot access anything but the pending-review screen until you approve it below, regardless of what role or permissions you set here.
text.this_pallet_is_sealed: This pallet is sealed. Unseal it to add items or adjust what is on it.
text.this_record_is_the: This record is the organization itself:
text.this_sorting_session_has: This sorting session has an item that is not saved yet (or lines still saving). Leave anyway?
text.unknown_pallet_tag_placeholder: Unknown pallet tag "{placeholder}". Check the label, or continue without a pallet.
text.uploading_only_previews_what: Uploading only previews what would happen — nothing is written until you Commit below.
text.using_the_one_in: Using the one in the server .env
text.volunteer_unpaid_independent_of: Volunteer (unpaid) — independent of their role below
text.we_haven_t_seen: We haven't seen this carton before.
text.whether_this_person_is: Whether this person is a volunteer is separate from their role — a volunteer can be an office manager or an administrator too. Feeds volunteer hours tracking.
text.you_don_t_have: You don't have permission to edit this record — they hold a permission you don't have. Showing read-only.
text.you_ll_need_to: You'll need to give them the password yourself. It isn't shown again after you save.
